title: Coin Path
description: Find the lexicographically smallest path from the first to the last index with jumps of size at most B.
pseudocode:
1: let n = A.length, B = jump
2: dp = new Array(n).fill(Infinity)
3: next = new Array(n).fill(-1)
4: dp[n-1] = A[n-1]
5: for i = n-2 down to 0:
6:   for j = 1 to B:
7:     if i+j < n and dp[i+j] + A[i] < dp[i]:
8:       dp[i] = dp[i+j] + A[i], next[i] = i+j

steps.note: Initialize DP array and next pointers for path reconstruction. A = [1, 2, 4, -1, 2], B = 2
Base case: start from the end index
Calculate DP[3] using jump to index 4
Calculate DP[2] by comparing jumps to index 3 and 4
Final path reconstruction starting from index 0
